title: Verify factorial, Touchard, and Narayana polynomial identities

source.citation: Enumerative combinatorics package for CoCoA, arXiv:2602.12372

translation.notes: A coherent exact subset of the CoCoA examples is rebuilt from definitions: rising and falling factorials, Touchard polynomials via Stirling numbers, and Narayana polynomials via binomial coefficients. The printed coefficients and specializations are checked.
